blocks.orig: Climbing Kilimanjaro, starting at a high altitude on the 6-day Lemosho-Shira Route
blocks.html: Climb Kilimanjaro from a high starting point on the 6-day Lemosho-Shira Route

blocks.orig: The Lemosho-Shira route starts on the Western Site of the Kilimanjaro. It is almost the same as the Lemosho route. But on the first day you ascent to the 2nd camp of the Lemosho route. Only after that the two routes correspond.
blocks.html: The Lemosho-Shira route begins on the western side of Kilimanjaro. It is nearly identical to the Lemosho route, except that on day one you climb to the second camp of the Lemosho route. From then on, both routes follow the same path.

blocks.orig: Your Tanzania Trip offers a unique service throughout the climb
blocks.html: Your Tanzania Trip gives you distinctive care for the entire climb

blocks.orig: Climbing Kilimanjaro is the ultimate challenge! Little details can make a world of difference, which is why with us, you climb with professional guides, porters, and a cook. They take care of you during your ascent via the Lemosho-Shira route, by checking your health twice a day and serving you delicious food. Sounds like a bit much? Not if you want to reach the top! Because we know that altitude sickness can creep up on you unnoticed and that proper nutrition* is essential to keep you going during a strenuous climb.
blocks.html: Climbing Kilimanjaro is the ultimate test! Small details can make a huge difference, so when you climb with us you are accompanied by professional guides, porters and a cook. On your way up the Lemosho-Shira route they look after you, checking your health twice a day and preparing tasty meals. Does that seem excessive? Not if reaching the summit is your goal! We know that altitude sickness can develop without you noticing, and that good nutrition* is vital to keep your energy up on a tough climb.

blocks.orig: *If you would like to see the menu, we can send it in advance.
blocks.html: *We are happy to send you the menu beforehand if you would like to see it.

blocks.orig: If you like advice on how to prepare yourself for climbing Kilimanjaro, you can always contact us or read our blog How to prepare for climbing Kilimanjaro?
blocks.html: For tips on getting ready to climb Kilimanjaro, feel free to get in touch with us or have a look at our blog How to prepare for climbing Kilimanjaro?

blocks.orig: When you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport our Your Tanzania Trip guide is there waiting for you. He then drops you off at your hotel, where you can relax from your flight.
blocks.html: On arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, your Your Tanzania Trip guide is already waiting. He takes you to your hotel so you can rest after the flight.

blocks.orig: Preparation for your climb: You meet your guide before the start of your climb, where he briefs you and offers advice on what to wear, what to pack, and other important tips to make your climb as comfortable as possible.
blocks.html: Getting ready for your climb: Before the climb starts you meet your guide for a briefing, with advice on clothing, packing and other useful tips to keep you as comfortable as possible on the mountain.

blocks.orig: Your guide picks you up in the morning and takes you on an approximately 4-hour drive to the Londorossi Gate, the west entrance of Kilimanjaro National Park. The road leads through a beautiful tropical rainforest. You arrive at the drop-off point at 3,500 meters where you can enjoy an amazing view of the Shira plateau for the first time. Immerse yourself in the beauty of nature and acclimatize to the high altitude while you prepare for an exciting adventure.
blocks.html: In the morning your guide collects you for a drive of about 4 hours to Londorossi Gate, the western entrance to Kilimanjaro National Park. The road runs through a lovely tropical rainforest. At the drop-off point at 3,500 metres you get your first wonderful view of the Shira plateau. Take in the natural beauty around you and let your body get used to the altitude as you get ready for an exciting adventure.

blocks.orig: On this second day on the mountain, the Lemosho route joins the Machame route. The hike leads from Shira 2 Camp to the beautiful Lava Tower at 4,630 m (15,190 ft). This part of the climb has many ascents and descents but offers beautiful views along the way. It is a long hike and you may start to feel a bit uncomfortable because of the height. It is therefore important to find the right pace for your body to adjust to the altitude. After lunch, you descend to Barranco Camp at the foot of Barranco Wall.
blocks.html: On your second day on the mountain, the Lemosho route merges with the Machame route. From Shira 2 Camp you walk to the striking Lava Tower at 4,630 m (15,190 ft). This section goes up and down a lot, yet rewards you with lovely views. It is a long day, and the altitude may start to make you feel a little unwell. That is why finding the right pace matters, so your body can get used to the height. After lunch you go down to Barranco Camp, at the base of Barranco Wall.

blocks.orig: For many people, this is their favourite part of the climb: going from Barranco Camp to the Barranco Wall. Once there, you have a spectacular view of the Kibo Volcano and Mount Meru.
blocks.html: Many climbers name this as the best part of the whole trek: the walk from Barranco Camp up the Barranco Wall. From there the views of the Kibo Volcano and Mount Meru are spectacular.

blocks.orig: Afterwards, a more difficult hike starts to reach Karanga Camp. This route has many ascents and descents, so keep the right pace. You have lunch at the camp and after a rest, you can take an acclimatization hike in the direction of Barafu Camp.
blocks.html: Next comes a tougher walk to Karanga Camp. The trail climbs and drops repeatedly, so keep a steady pace. Lunch is at the camp, and after some rest you can go on an acclimatisation walk towards Barafu Camp.

blocks.orig: After breakfast the hike to Barafu Camp starts. This is the starting point for your ascent to the Uhuru Peak - the top of Kilimanjaro! You arrive at the camp around lunch. Have a rest and after you regain your strength, take an acclimatization hike to Kosovo Summit Camp (4,870m) and back. Enjoy breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks and experience the thrill of high-altitude camping as you prepare for the final push to the summit around midnight.
blocks.html: Once breakfast is over, you set off for Barafu Camp. From here you start your climb to Uhuru Peak - the summit of Kilimanjaro! You reach camp at about lunchtime. Take a rest, and once you feel stronger, do an acclimatisation walk to Kosovo Summit Camp (4,870m) and back. Take in the stunning views of the peaks around you and the excitement of camping at high altitude while you get ready for the final summit push at around midnight.

blocks.orig: Today is the day! Around midnight you start from Barafu Camp to Uhuru Peak. The climb leads over good trails and the most challenging part is the high altitude. Once you reach the summit, you can enjoy a beautiful sunrise, which is quite impressive at this height! After a short time at the top, where you celebrate your ultimate triumph, you descend slowly to the scenic Millennium Camp.
blocks.html: This is the big day! At around midnight you set off from Barafu Camp towards Uhuru Peak. The paths are good, and the hardest part is the high altitude. At the summit, you can watch a beautiful sunrise, which is truly impressive at this height! After a short stay on top to celebrate your great achievement, you slowly make your way down to the scenic Millennium Camp.

blocks.orig: The Millenium Camp is located in a tropical rainforest. When you wake up today, you feel a sense of relief from the reduced altitude and satisfaction from reaching the summit. After breakfast, you take an easy walk to the park exit.
blocks.html: The Millenium Camp lies in a tropical rainforest. Waking up today, you feel relieved at the lower altitude and satisfied at having reached the summit. After breakfast, an easy walk brings you to the park exit.

blocks.orig: Your driver then brings you back to the hotel for a well-deserved rest!
blocks.html: Your driver then takes you back to the hotel, where a well-earned rest awaits!

blocks.orig: Sadly, this is the end of your holiday and the time to go home has arrived. Enjoy your last hours in Tanzania before our driver comes to pick you up and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still longing for more? It's also possible to add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
blocks.html: Unfortunately your holiday has come to an end and it is time to travel home. Make the most of your final hours in Tanzania until our driver collects you and brings you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight back. Want more? You can also combine your Kilimanjaro adventure with a few days of safari or a beach holiday!
